BEFORE YOU FALL IN LOVE

A few things
you might wonder.

Have another question?
How do I place an order?+

Add your favourites to your bag and select “Order on WhatsApp”. Review and send the message. We’ll confirm the pieces, availability and final price with you.

Can I see more photos or ask about sizing?+

Of course. Open a product and choose “Ask about this piece” to request actual photos, fabric details, measurements or available sizes on WhatsApp.

How do I check delivery and returns?+

Message us with your location and the piece you’re interested in. Please confirm delivery charges, expected delivery time and any return or exchange conditions before ordering.
